text: Kickoff for the DS bootcamp content sprint. Weeks 1 to 3 notebooks are ours. Pandas Basics is due Oct 19 and Data Cleaning and EDA is due Oct 21. Omar owns Pandas Basics, Lena owns Data Cleaning and EDA.
